pages.text: The pack's quest book — your guided tour and bonus-reward track. Heracles lays out worthwhile objectives tier by tier and rewards you for completing them.

$(bold)How it fits:$() Heracles works alongside the Iridescent Codex token economy. The $(bold)Codex$() decides $(italic)when$() you advance a tier (see $(l:icraft:progression/tier_gates)How You Advance$(/l)); the $(bold)quests$() suggest good ways to get there and track your boss-rush progress.$(br2)$(bold)Not a gate:$() you can advance purely through the Codex without touching a quest. Quests are guidance and bonus loot — never mandatory.

$(bold)Rewards:$() completing quests grants bonus loot and extra rewards beyond the minimum needed to progress. Optional objectives are worth doing for the spoils, but you are never forced down any single path.
